messages:
maria: FYI PR #12100 is failing CI intermittently on the new kv cache eviction test, looks like a timing heisenbug. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/12100

aj: saw that, failure is `kv_cache_test::eviction_race` -- only on shard-3 so far. stack traces point at race in background flusher.

sophia: can you paste the failing log snippet?

maria: sure, here's the failing assert from CI run:```
thread 'tests::eviction_race' panicked at 'expected key present, got None', src/cache/kv_cache.rs:412:18
--- async tasks: flusher @ tokio::spawn, test writer @ tokio::spawn
```

ci-bot: build #67892 on ubuntu-20.04 (shard-3) failed: tests::eviction_race (exit code 101) :rotating_light:

aj: my hunch is a timing window introduced by the new batch flush config. locally I can't reproduce reliably but I can run the test in a loop on a beefy instance.

liam: is this PR blocked from merge automatically by the merge-queue?

maria: yes, merge-bot holds it until CI is green. I can trigger a rerun for the specific shard if we want.

devops-jen: recommend not merging even if a single rerun passes. For flake classification we require 2 successful reruns within the same hour before we consider thawing the merge hold, unless a reviewer signs off on risk.

aj: I can run an extended stress loop (100 runs) on a c6g.large to try to reproduce and capture a trace. If it fails I'll push a debug build with extra logging.

sophia: I can review the code path today. If it's a harmless timing window we could add retry logic in the test or a small sleep, but I'd prefer to fix the root cause.

maria: thanks. I'll trigger shard-3 rerun now and add a note to the PR: "running stress loop + seeking two green reruns per policy".

ci-bot: manually triggered rerun #67893 for shard-3 by maria.

aj: pinging @liam for approval if we decide to hotfix with a test guard while we investigate.

liam: OK to approve a guarded test change (e.g., increase timeout / assert with retry) if you include a TODO and an issue linking to follow-up fix. Prefer not to change production code for test flakiness.

maria: agreed. plan: (1) aj runs stress and posts traces (2) sophia triages the race and proposes fix (3) if we need a short-term test guard we'll add it + TODO, get liam approval and get two green reruns before merge.

aj: starting stress job now, ETA ~45m. I'll post results here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sophia: will look at code in the meantime.

maria: thanks team. I'll leave the merge hold message on the PR and update when we have rerun results. :thumbsup:
